test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If x + y = 7 and xy = 19, then calculate the value of x² + y².
solution:
Given:

x + y = 7

xy = 19

Formula Used:

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

Calculation:

x + y = 7

Squaring both sides

⇒ (x + y)² = 7²

⇒ x² + y² + 2xy = 49

⇒ x² + y² = 49 - 2 × 19

⇒ x² + y² = 11

∴ The value of x² + y² is 11.
